content: The Prototipo RS - Red/Black/Orange features all-day comfort and versatility, with additional padding on the tongue, heel, and collar; an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control; and a removable, contoured cork & EVA foam insole with perforated footbed.
